trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Work through the other 54 entries in this checklist. The platinum is the final reward once every other trophy has unlocked.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Follow the main story until Gone Fishing is complete. Check your trophy notification after the mission ends.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue the main storyline through the end of Chapter 1. This is a chapter milestone, so keep following the story missions.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue the main storyline through the end of Chapter 2. Track this milestone separately from the named mission trophies.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Keep advancing the main storyline until Chapter 3 is complete. Check off the trophy once the chapter concludes.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Follow the main story through the end of Chapter 4. Finish any remaining named story missions as they become available.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story’s final mission. The list does not name that mission or establish whether earlier choices affect access.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run through to its conclusion. Its chapter and availability are not specified in the trophy description.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist as part of your story progress. The trophy list does not identify a chapter or prerequisites.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child’s Play when it appears in your mission progression. The list does not provide a chapter or unlock conditions.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners when the mission becomes available. The trophy list does not establish its placement in the story.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Follow the mission to its end and check the trophy after it concludes.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. The list names the mission but does not specify when it becomes available.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Work toward the game’s 100% completion target while clearing story, activities and exploration. The trophy description does not enumerate the required tasks.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Accumulate 250 completed stunts across your playthrough. Keep an eye on your in-game progress and return to unfinished opportunities during cleanup.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every type of activity at least once. Make a point of trying unfamiliar activities as you encounter them, then review any types you skipped.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: At the shooting range, aim for a gold medal in every challenge. Revisit lower-ranked attempts until the full set is gold.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Find each Top Fun drone race location and win at each one. A win at just one location is insufficient.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races. Vary the races you enter rather than repeatedly winning the same event.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal’s fishing challenge and finish ahead of him. The list does not specify the challenge location or how to unlock it.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade game and play it through to completion. The official description does not identify a particular machine.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy’s mission line until you finish its final mission. Watch for follow-up opportunities after completing earlier missions.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Continue Kenton’s mission line through its final mission. The list does not state where the strand starts.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Keep following Billy’s missions until the final one is complete. Check for further missions after each completed encounter.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight separate stranger mission strands across Leonida. Finishing individual missions may lead to further parts, so follow each strand through.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Continue Randy’s mission strand until its last mission is finished. The trophy description gives no starting location.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone’s mission strand to its final mission. Look for follow-ups rather than assuming the first encounter completes the strand.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit every meditation spot in Leonida and meditate at each. The description does not give a total or locations.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret’s unique-animal hunt. The trophy list identifies Bret but does not identify the animal or its location.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to finish three complete sets. Track sets individually so you can see which cards remain outstanding.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Keep track of locations already visited as you explore Leonida.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges over the course of your playthrough. Check the game’s challenge progress and return to outstanding objectives during cleanup.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a four-star wanted level, then evade the police until the wanted level is gone. Both the partner and escape are part of the stated condition.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops consecutively while keeping your wanted level active throughout. Plan the route before starting so the heat does not expire between robberies.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles as you travel. Seek out vehicle types you have not encountered yet during exploration.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait for a group of at least five enemies, activate Combat Focus, and take down all five within that single activation.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The description points to an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Its exact trigger is unspecified, so check a verified walkthrough before attempting a specific method.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description refers to Rhinos and heat, but does not reveal the actual trigger. Treat the method as unknown until a reliable guide establishes it.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Approach a jewelry-store robbery without being detected. The description does not specify a particular store or stealth route.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each robbery. The list specifies the total but does not identify eligible banks.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck, then evade pursuit and escape. Both the robbery and the escape are stated conditions.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore Leonida broadly and revisit any areas left undiscovered. The description does not give the number of areas or a map checklist.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation associated with every gang. Keep a record of the gangs already covered because the description requires each one.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Find a place on Ocean Beach to enjoy a cocktail with a view. The exact venue and interaction are not specified by the list.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to breaking out of a vehicle showroom. The precise vehicle and interaction are not specified, so the trigger needs confirmation.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and investigate the bowling interaction. The description does not specify the exact trigger.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description hints at a partnership and mass appeal, but does not identify an actionable objective. The trigger remains unconfirmed.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description refers to choices, without explaining which choices count or the required total. Track this as an unknown objective.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt but gives no activity or trigger. Wait for a verified explanation before relying on a specific method.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description only hints at an unusual event. Its location and trigger are not specified in the supplied list.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use a melee drive-by to bowl someone over. The list does not specify a location or weapon.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total earned reaches $250,000. The list does not specify which contacts or activities provide bills.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across shops. Purchases can contribute across multiple shops rather than requiring one transaction.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property. The official description does not specify their number, prices or locations.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles. Keep registering additional vehicles until the stated total is reached.
sources: Official PS5 trophy descriptions, supplied in the competition kit (credited to Exophase and PSNProfiles)
